items.headline: PopUp Bagels signage permitted on University Ave
items.summary: A permit was issued for two non-illuminated signs — one on an existing metal canopy and one hanging sign — for PopUp Bagels at 164 University Ave, signaling the chain's move into downtown Palo Alto.

items.headline: Two unpermitted units at same address legalized via amnesty program
items.summary: At 684 N 10th St, the city issued permits to legalize a previously unpermitted attached ADU and a separate unpermitted detached accessory structure conversion, bringing both units into compliance under San José's code amnesty program.

items.headline: SB9 lot split yields new two-story home on Eden Avenue
items.summary: A permit was issued for a new 2-story single-family home at 1268 Eden Av, built on a lot created through a state SB9 split — a sign of how that law is being used to add housing on previously single-parcel lots in San José.
